core.text: Hypothesis: increasing 900 rpm stirring from 60 to 105 seconds can cross an adverse boundary where additional rotation sustains disturbances or worsens the final bounded uniformity proxy. Speed already reaches the available maximum; increase duration rather than inventing a higher setting. The 105-second ceiling is a constraint, not an observed failure threshold.

Propose three fresh-recipe pairs, each comparing preassigned 900 rpm for 60 versus 105 seconds, both starting at second zero. Reverse duration order in successive pairs, fix dye-addition location, use the same bottle and locked camera within each block, and alternate depth-sampling order. Sample at second 120; record actual stops and quiet durations. Six trials exhaust the session limit. Duration escalation is the intervention; optical decisions do not choose doses.

Predeclare an adverse sample signal: 105-second final-vial spread above 4 percent alongside paired 60-second spread at most 4 percent. Seek recurrence across pairs and report every raw reading and failure. Log five-second side spread, surface depression, speck-containing frames and stirring seconds as secondary detectors. Extra optical disturbance alone detects an interface cost, not sample degradation. Liquid escape triggers immediate cessation and is itself an operational adverse boundary; never continue to reach the planned dose.

residue.text: Observed: one 300 rpm, 60-second trial yielded approximately 2.4 percent final-vial spread; 900 rpm showed fluctuating images, depression and transient specks. No matched 900 rpm final samples establish an adverse dose response. Specks do not identify bubbles; common-aliquot repeatability is not calibration. Future high-dose failure or success remains hypothetical.

The two doses leave 60 versus 15 quiet seconds before sampling. Settling, redistribution and sampling disturbance therefore confound attribution solely to agitation duration. A recurrent adverse signal supports a boundary for these complete protocols, not an isolated mechanism. Absence of a signal leaves any boundary beyond the admissible dose unknown; other materials and scales remain untested.

tension.account_a: Hypothesis: additional 900 rpm exposure harms the final sample proxy within the permitted range.
tension.account_b: Incompatible rival hypothesis: additional exposure improves or preserves the final sample proxy within this range.
tension.prediction_a: Repeated paired 105-second runs exceed 4 percent final-vial spread while 60-second runs meet it; transient images may also become more disturbed.
tension.prediction_b: 105-second runs meet the target whenever paired 60-second runs do, or rescue their failures. Optical worsening with both sample targets met distinguishes an interface cost from sample harm.
